name: User birthday greeting
description: Greeting sent on the user's birthday.

name: User OTP — SMS
description: One-time password delivered to the user. Fixed to the `sms` channel type — whichever SMS gateway module the installation runs registers its channel as type "sms". Enabled by default: this is the only way a login code goes out — without it (or without an SMS channel) sign-in fails with send_failed.

name: Sign-in method added — SMS
description: The owner is told a new way into the account was added. Fixed to the `sms` channel type and marked important on purpose: SMS is the only channel tied to the SIM rather than to a session, and a session is what an attacker already has. The message names no detail of the change and carries no link — a "this wasn't me" link would be a new unauthenticated entry point on the very channel this notice defends. Sent to the number on record BEFORE the change. Turning this rule off removes the alarm; AUTH_LINK_NOTICE_POLICY=off turns all of them off at once.

default.title: Account security
default.body: Your account sign-in methods have changed. If this was not you, contact support.
